messages:
maria.ortega: Quick sprint digest — small docs sweep this week. I found 2 broken anchors in the runtime guide and one API example that doesn't match the SDK snippet. Can someone take these quick PRs? cc @sam.kent @ben.choi

sam.kent: I can take the runtime guide anchors. Which files/anchors?

maria.ortega: Thanks. Links: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache.md#prefetching (anchor 404) and https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/compilation.md#kernel-selection (anchor moved). Example: the runtime file shows `#prefetching` but the heading is now `Prefetch strategy` — so anchor mismatch.

ben.choi: I can handle the API snippet mismatch. Looks like the JS example uses old SDK shape. I’ll update to the new async client with streaming example. Opening PR now.

alana.patel: Quick ask — can we also confirm none of these touches the oncall runbook? Oncall handoff is Tue and we need the runbook links stable.

docs-bot: link-scan report: 3 failing links found in docs/runtime (2 missing anchors, 1 image 403). Scan id: scan-20260319-09. Summary: anchors: kv-cache#prefetching, compilation#kernel-selection; image: /assets/runtime/arch-diagram.png 403.

maria.ortega: Perfect — Sam please fix the anchors + add a redirect frontmatter if you have to. Ben, send PR w/ changelog entry and note for docs reviewers. Alana — the oncall runbook references are in /handbooks/oncall.md, I checked — they point to compilation.md by slug (not anchor) so should be okay.

sam.kent: Will do. Plan: change headings to canonical slug-friendly form, add frontmatter redirect: `redirect_from: ["/runtime/kv-cache#prefetching"]` and open PR with small sed patch. ETA: EOD today.

ben.choi: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — updates JS SDK example, adds test for example output. Labelled `docs + quickfix`.

maria.ortega: Awesome — can folks give a quick CR ping when ready? I’ll merge after a quick review so we can run the link scanner again before Tue. :thumbsup:

sam.kent: :thumbsup: will ping in PR thread when ready.

ben.choi: tagging @maria.ortega for review now. ETA 1h.

maria.ortega: Thanks all — adding short note to standup for handoff and closing this sweep once PRs merge.
